company.name: ModernFi
company.shortDescription: ModernFi is a deposit network company that provides extended insurance to depositors through program institutions.
company.description: ModernFi operates a deposit network through which institutions can grow, retain, and manage their deposit base by sweeping funds, sourcing deposits, and providing extended insurance to depositors through program institutions. ModernFi’s solutions help institutions attract and retain large-value depositors, driving growth and increasing balance sheet stability.

productsAndServices.description: A network that enables financial institutions to offer extended deposit insurance, source overnight funding, and sweep excess deposits to manage balance sheets.

productsAndServices.description: A data product that helps financial institutions identify, research, and acquire new large-value clients and members.

productsAndServices.description: Software that enables financial institutions to source cost-effective term funding on demand to manage their balance sheets.
productsAndServices.name: Term Funding

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows financial institutions to sweep excess deposits off their balance sheets into the ModernFi Network to generate income and manage balance sheet size.
productsAndServices.name: Sweep Program

productsAndServices.description: A funding solution that provides financial institutions with access to stable, non-collateralized overnight or term funding from other institutions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,000,000, or 51.46% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,762,336 to $207,480,049, a 55.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
